description: No recording disclosure, premium quoted before the waiting-period disclosure, then two risky statements.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Neha from Prithvi Health. Am I speaking with Miss Kapoor?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You wanted a family health plan, right? Who all should be covered?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Me, my husband and our son, he is six.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Perfect, our family floater FamilyShield is ideal. With ten lakh cover the premium comes to about twenty three thousand rupees a year.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hmm. My husband has diabetes, will that be covered?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Don't worry, diabetes is covered from day one, and with us claims are guaranteed to be approved.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: So shall I go ahead and create the proposal for you today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Let me think about it. Can you call me back tomorrow evening?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure, I will call you tomorrow. Thank you.
